name: cockpit-cards-dismiss
description: The cards view's third choice: a person enters the cockpit through the mode switch, opens its cards view, selects the session-ask card, presses 「Ignore / discard」 and then 「Confirm discard」. Every assertion is a structured reading of the list's own `data-cockpit-cards` declaration; the dismiss verb presses the card's own two-step control (the dismiss button, then the bar's confirm), never the option bar — so the card settles without answering it. After the dismissal the card has left the visible list, every other card stays in order, the selection falls back to the first remaining card, and the list-level answer reads as a success. Run this against an instance whose `cockpit.fixtureFeedback.mode` is not `none`: the shipped `closed` arm and a `kept` arm both close a dismissed item, while `none` answers no receipt and leaves the card in place.
